title: Physics Body
description: Adds gravity, velocity, drag, and collision response to an entity. Pair Physics Body with a Multi-Collider so the entity moves and reacts like a physical object.

blocks.content: The **Physics Body** component connects an entity to the 2D physics simulation. It controls how gravity, velocity, mass, and sloped surfaces affect the entity. Pair it with a [Multi-Collider](components/multi_collider) so it can collide with walls, floors, and other entities.

items.title: Three Body Types
items.desc: Choose **Dynamic** for characters and props, **Static** for walls, or **Kinematic** for scripted platforms.

items.title: Slope Alignment
items.desc: Turn on **Align to Slope** to rotate characters smoothly along angled terrain.

items.title: Live Simulation Toggle
items.desc: Pause or resume physics on individual entities at any time.

items: Select the entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and select **Physics Body**.
Click **Add Component...** again and select **Collider** so the physics body has a collision shape.

rows: Toggles **Running** or **Paused** to enable or freeze physics updates on this entity.
Sets the simulation mode: **Dynamic (Standard)** reacts to gravity and forces, **Static (Immovable)** never moves, and **Kinematic (Scripted)** moves by velocity without being pushed by gravity.
Mass of the body in kilograms (minimum 0.1).
Resistance that slows velocity over time (minimum 0).
Multiplier for scene gravity on this entity. Set to **0** for top-down games or flying entities.
Rotates the entity automatically to match the angle of sloped surfaces beneath it.
Visible when **Align to Slope** is checked. Controls how fast the entity rotates to match a slope.
Visible when **Align to Slope** is checked. Steepest slope angle (5 to 89 degrees) the entity can climb.

blocks.message: Set **Gravity Scale** to **0** when building top-down RPGs or shooters so characters do not fall downward.

blocks.content: Choose the right combination of **Body Type** and **Gravity Scale** for common gameplay entities.

rows: Check **Align to Slope** if your level has angled ramps.
Set **Linear Drag** to **5.00** or higher for crisp stopping.
Move with [Ping Pong Stepper](node_library/helper_tool#node-pingPongStepper) or velocity nodes.
Blocks dynamic entities without being pushed.

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Physics & Collision](node_library/game_physics) and [Helper & Tool](node_library/helper_tool) to move bodies and read physics states at runtime.

Entity falls right through the floor
Make sure both the entity and the floor have a [Multi-Collider](components/multi_collider) set to **Solid (Physics)** (or a [Tilemap](components/renderers/tilemap) with **Solid** checked).
Entity rotates on a slope, tilting its solid collider into the ground
In the entity's **Collider** section, check **Lock World Rotation (Stay Upright)** so the visual sprite tilts to the slope while the physical collider stays upright.
